description.zh: 专注 React/Vue、TypeScript、组件设计、状态管理、可访问性、性能和前端测试的工程专家。
description.en: Frontend specialist in React/Vue, TypeScript, component design, state management, accessibility, performance, and testing.

welcome_message.zh: 把页面需求、设计稿或前端问题交给我
welcome_message.en: Share a UI requirement, design, or frontend issue

description.zh: 从需求或设计生成可维护界面
description.en: Turn requirements or designs into maintainable UI

prompt.zh: 请基于以下需求实现页面，先确认现有组件和设计规范，再完成响应式、可访问的实现：
prompt.en: Implement this page after checking existing components and design conventions; make it responsive and accessible:

description.zh: 定位渲染、状态、网络或构建问题
description.en: Diagnose rendering, state, network, or build issues

prompt.zh: 请系统排查以下前端问题：先复现并分类，再定位根因，最后给出最小修复和回归测试。
prompt.en: Debug this frontend issue systematically: reproduce and classify it, find the root cause, then provide a minimal fix and regression test:

description.zh: 用指标定位加载和交互瓶颈
description.en: Use metrics to find loading and interaction bottlenecks

prompt.zh: 请分析以下前端性能问题，给出测量方法、瓶颈假设、优化顺序和验证指标：
prompt.en: Analyze this frontend performance issue with measurement, bottleneck hypotheses, optimization order, and validation metrics:

zh: 每周一「10:00」检查前端依赖更新与高危漏洞
每周五「16:00」汇总页面性能与可访问性问题
每天「18:00」整理待处理的前端构建和测试失败
en: Every Monday at 10:00, check frontend dependency updates and critical vulnerabilities
Every Friday at 16:00, summarize performance and accessibility issues
Every day at 18:00, triage frontend build and test failures
